scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained, with an explicit homeomorphism, exact ratio shift, full periodic orbit classification, entropy lower bounds and necessary/sufficient convergence criteria. Finite diagnostic code cannot certify infinite-dimensional claims; an independent assessment is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: The full-shift conjugacy is limited to full-support probability laws whose normalized consecutive Bessel-type tail ratios lie in one fixed nondegenerate compact positive interval. It does not classify transforms for unbounded or vanishing ratios, and does not establish mathematical priority beyond the inspected literature.
title: Full-shift dynamics and exact Bessel-attraction criteria for centered quadratic bias
